standard.summary: acceleration_profile 是一键加速预设，自动组合 torch.compile、attention 后端、缓存策略等优化。提供 off/safe/balanced/aggressive/low_vram 五档。
standard.effect: safe 只启用最安全的优化（如 SDPA）；balanced 加入 torch.compile + cache；aggressive 开启所有优化（可能影响兼容性）；low_vram 优先节省显存。
standard.whenToUse: 不想手动配置各种性能选项时。balanced 是推荐的默认选择。
standard.avoidWhen: 需要精确控制每个优化选项时不要使用预设。调试性能问题时关闭预设逐项测试。

optionDescriptions.off: 加速预设全关，参数原样，方便跟别的档对比。
optionDescriptions.safe: 只开比较稳的那几项（缓存、foreach 之类），提速不多，也不怎么折腾。
optionDescriptions.balanced: 按这个模型给的常用加速组合开，速度和折腾程度都还行。
optionDescriptions.aggressive: compile、快路径能开就开；第一次编译会久一点，怪配置也更容易出问题。
optionDescriptions.low_vram: 先省显存：缓存往盘上扔、checkpoint 卸掉；速度一般会慢一截。

standard_en.summary: acceleration_profile is a one-click acceleration preset that combines torch.compile, the attention backend, cache policy and other optimisations for you. Five levels: off / safe / balanced / aggressive / low_vram.
standard_en.effect: safe enables only the safest optimisations such as SDPA; balanced adds torch.compile plus caching; aggressive turns everything on and may affect compatibility; low_vram puts saving VRAM first.
standard_en.whenToUse: When you would rather not configure each performance option by hand. balanced is the recommended default.
standard_en.avoidWhen: Do not use a preset when you need exact control over each optimisation. Turn the preset off and test item by item when debugging a performance problem.

optionDescriptions.off: All acceleration presets off, parameters left as they are -- handy as a baseline to compare the other levels against.
optionDescriptions.safe: Only the sturdy items (caching, foreach and the like). Not much faster, but not much to go wrong either.
optionDescriptions.balanced: The usual acceleration combination for this model. Decent speed, decent amount of fuss.
optionDescriptions.aggressive: compile and the fast paths get turned on wherever possible. The first compile takes noticeably longer and odd configurations break more easily.
optionDescriptions.low_vram: VRAM first: caches go to disk, checkpointing is offloaded. Usually a fair bit slower.

advanced.principle: acceleration_profile 会批量设置多个底层参数：attention_backend（auto→flash2/sdpa）、torch_compile（True/False + mode）、compile_runtime（off→compile/cudagraph）、native_cache_mode（cache_first）、weight_compression（off→fp8）、以及各 swap/offload 选项。aggressive 模式下 compile_fullgraph=True + cudagraph 组合可能获得最大加速但兼容性风险最高。
advanced.intervention: config validator 阶段根据预设自动设置底层参数。
advanced.expectedImpact: balanced 通常提速 30-50%。aggressive 可达 2-3 倍。low_vram 在显存受限时提速 20-40%。
advanced.tradeoffs: 预设可能与特定模型/硬件不兼容。建议先用 balanced，稳定后再尝试 aggressive。

advanced_en.principle: acceleration_profile batch-sets many low-level parameters: attention_backend (auto→flash2/sdpa), torch_compile (True/False + mode), compile_runtime (off→compile/cudagraph), native_cache_mode (cache_first), weight_compression (off→fp8), plus the various swap/offload options. In aggressive mode the compile_fullgraph=True + cudagraph combination may yield the greatest speedup but carries the highest compatibility risk.
advanced_en.intervention: The config validator stage sets the low-level parameters automatically per preset.
advanced_en.expectedImpact: balanced usually speeds up 30-50%. aggressive can reach 2-3×. low_vram speeds up 20-40% when VRAM-constrained.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: Presets may be incompatible with specific models/hardware. Start with balanced, then try aggressive once stable.
